name: Ownership Intelligence & Capital Strategy
description: Deterministic strategic framework to audit capitalization tables, model dilution scenarios, compute liquidation waterfalls, optimize option pool reserves, and structure long-term capital allocation strategies.
frameworks: 1x Non-Participating vs Participating Preferred Waterfall Framework
logic: Ownership structure dictates control, alignment, and economic returns. Unmodeled dilution, misconfigured option pools, or predatory liquidation preferences permanently erode founder ownership and investor value. Execute mathematically precise capitalization management.
chainsOfThought: Step 1: Initiate Cap Table Audit -> Inventory Common Stock, Preferred Shares, Options & SAFE Notes -> Verify Fully-Diluted Share Count
Step 2: Dilution Scenario Modeling -> Input Financing Round Terms (Pre-Money Valuation, Investment Amount, Option Pool Refresh) -> Calculate Post-Round Dilution & Share Prices
Step 3: SAFE & Convertible Note Conversion -> Compute Conversion Prices (Valuation Cap vs Discount Rate) -> Map Issuance of Series Preferred Shares
Step 4: Liquidation Waterfall Analysis -> Model Exit Valuations -> Compute Preferred Liquidation Preferences (1x Non-Participating) vs Common Stock Proceeds
Step 5: Executive & Board Sign-Off -> Broadcast WebSocket Approval Request via ExecApprovalManager -> Obtain Founder Sign-Off
Step 6: Export Capital Strategy Package -> Generate Cap Table Ledger JSON, Pro-Forma CSV, Waterfall MD & Capital Strategy Brief -> Archive in Vault
Step 7: Continuous Ownership Monitoring -> Track Option Pool Reserves, Vesting Schedules & Conversion Triggers -> Notify Leadership
bestPractices: Always model dilution on a fully-diluted basis including all issued options, unallocated reserves, and convertibles.
Require explicit human founder sign-off before modifying cap table ledgers or authorizing new equity issuances.
Verify pre-money option pool expansion impact on effective valuation prior to term sheet execution.
